headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals continued their winning streak with an 8-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, led by Jordan Walker's home run and three RBIs. In a thrilling finish, the Reds edged out the Cardinals 7-6, with Walker also leading the Cardinals' offense with three hits, including a home run, and four RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Lourdes Gurriel Jr. of the Arizona Diamondbacks, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Other players on the injured list include Carter Baumler of the Texas Rangers, Jordan Hicks of the Chicago White Sox, Mickey Moniak of the Colorado Rockies, Jung Hoo Lee of the San Francisco Giants, Burch Smith of the Detroit Tigers, Ke'Bryan Hayes of the Cincinnati Reds, and Yoán Moncada of the Los Angeles Angels.

The Philadelphia Phillies made a roster move, trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money. Other notable trades include the Cincinnati Reds trading RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, the Tampa Bay Rays trading LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, and the Toronto Blue Jays trading LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Cardinals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 7-6 in a closely contested game. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Walker leading the offense and Kai-Wei Teng pitching a strong 6.0 innings.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, with Patrick Corbin earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Gurriel Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies on May 22, 2026, in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.
